'''Chad Thompson''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 16th at [[November 2000 Rochester tournament]] on 4 November 2000, according to Peter Jacobson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1432">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-07-director-s-report-rochester-mn-11-4-00d1432/ director-s-report-rochester-mn-11-4-00], DeckTech (Peter "jeeps" Jacobson, 7 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-07-director-s-report-rochester-mn-11-4-00d1432/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
